content.title: United Natural Foods (NYSE:UNFI) Misses Q3 CY2025 Revenue Estimates
content.summary: Food distribution company United Natural Foods (NYSE:UNFI) fell short of the markets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales flat year on year at $7.84 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $31.8 billion at the midpoint came in 0.7% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.56 per share was 40.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
